files.description: Library Health (/library/health): scan stats, the Library status cards and their fixes (Index them, Remove them, Regenerate thumbnails), the all-clear, and the utilities responsive contract.

testContext: /library/health renders the shell instantly, then streams the scan as NDJSON: progress records tick #stat-total-filesystem; the final done record fills #stat-total-imported/#stat-total-indexed/#stat-unindexed/#stat-orphaned/#stat-missing-thumbnails (all start as an em-dash; missing thumbnails stays a dash only when the thumbnail folder can't be checked) and the Library status section: one .issue-card per problem (#issue-unindexed, #issue-orphaned, #issue-missing-thumbnails, and the server-rendered #issue-failed), each with a count title (#issue-<key>-title), its fix button (#index-new-button, #remove-orphaned-button, #regenerate-thumbnails-button, #retry-failed-button) and files under a 'Show files' <details> (#issue-<key>-files). #status-in-sync ('Everything is in sync') shows only when no card or warning applies. Each fix POSTs, toasts, and reloads.
explanation: Rewritten by hand from specs/index_photos.yaml for the Library Health revamp (issue cards replaced the Sync Database button and result tables). Every test fits the 30-second budget: the fix flows are split into serial steps with one background job each. The regenerate test assigns a face through the app's JSON endpoints, finds its crop file by content (sandbox-fs findFileWithContentIn), deletes it, and checks it comes back with the face still assigned.
